AudioFrame.description:
A stereo frame containing one audio sample per channel.

**Used for** passing the two channels of a sample together through Godot's audio processing.

fields.left:
The audio sample for the left channel.

**Used for** mixing or processing the left output channel without changing the right channel.
fields.right:
The audio sample for the right channel.

**Used for** mixing or processing the right output channel without changing the left channel.

CaretInfo.description:
The caret rectangles and text directions at a position in shaped text.

**Used for** returning both caret placements for one text position from a text server extension.

fields.leading_caret:
The rectangle for the caret at the leading side of the text position.

**Used for** drawing the caret for the leading side of a text position.
fields.trailing_caret:
The rectangle for the caret at the trailing side of the text position.

**Used for** drawing the caret for the trailing side of a text position.
fields.leading_direction:
The text direction associated with the leading caret.

**Used for** selecting how to draw the leading caret in bidirectional text.
fields.trailing_direction:
The text direction associated with the trailing caret.

**Used for** selecting how to draw the trailing caret in bidirectional text.

Glyph.description:
A glyph in shaped text, with its source string offsets, font, and placement relative to the baseline.

**Used for** returning shaped text from a text server extension for drawing and hit testing.

fields.start:
The starting offset of the glyph's text in the source string.

**Used for** mapping a displayed glyph back to the beginning of its source text.
fields.end:
The ending offset of the glyph's text in the source string.

**Used for** locating the source-text boundary after the shaped glyph.
fields.count:
The number of glyphs in the grapheme. The text server stores this count in the first glyph.

**Used for** stepping from the first glyph of one grapheme to the next grapheme.
fields.repeat:
How many times to draw this glyph in succession.

**Used for** drawing consecutive copies, such as when shaping repeated leader marks.
fields.flags:
Flags describing the grapheme. The text server stores them in the first glyph.

**Used for** checking the grapheme's direction or whether it contains a valid or virtual glyph.
fields.x_off:
The horizontal offset from the glyph origin on the baseline.

**Used for** placing the glyph horizontally relative to the current drawing origin.
fields.y_off:
The vertical offset from the glyph origin on the baseline.

**Used for** placing the glyph vertically relative to the current drawing origin.
fields.advance:
The advance to the next glyph along the baseline. It applies to X in horizontal text and Y in vertical text.

**Used for** moving the drawing origin along the horizontal or vertical layout axis after the glyph.
fields.font_rid:
The RID of the font resource supplying the glyph.

**Used for** selecting the font resource to use when drawing the glyph.
fields.font_size:
The size at which the font supplies the glyph.

**Used for** selecting the glyph size to draw from the selected font.
fields.index:
The font's glyph index. For an invalid glyph, this holds the UTF-32 code point.

**Used for** selecting the font glyph to draw or identifying the missing code point.

PhysicsServer2DExtensionRayResult.description:
The result of a 2D ray intersection query.

**Used for** reporting a hit from a 2D ray query in a physics server extension.

fields.position:
The point where the ray intersects the collider, in world coordinates.

**Used for** placing an effect or marker at the ray hit.
fields.normal:
The surface normal at the ray intersection, in world coordinates.

**Used for** orienting an effect or computing a reflection at the ray hit.
fields.rid:
The physics server RID of the object found by the query.

**Used for** addressing the collider in a later physics server operation.
fields.collider_id:
The instance ID of the Godot object found by the query.

**Used for** looking up the Godot object associated with the result by instance ID.
fields.collider:
Object pointer associated with the hit, if available.

**Used for** accessing the hit object directly when the query supplies an object pointer.
fields.shape:
The index of the matching shape on the collider.

**Used for** selecting which of the collider's shapes the query found.

Identifies a shape found by a 2D intersection query.

**Used for** returning collider identities and shape indices from a 2D overlap query.

fields.rid:
The physics server RID of the object found by the query.

**Used for** addressing the collider in a later physics server operation.
fields.collider_id:

**Used for** looking up the Godot object associated with the result by instance ID.
fields.collider:
Object pointer associated with the overlap, if available.

**Used for** accessing the hit object directly when the query supplies an object pointer.
fields.shape:
The index of the matching shape on the collider.

**Used for** selecting which of the collider's shapes the query found.

PhysicsServer2DExtensionShapeRestInfo.description:
Contact information for the closest shape returned by a 2D rest query.

**Used for** returning the contact chosen by a 2D shape rest query.

fields.point:
The contact point on the collider.

**Used for** locating the reported contact on the collider.
fields.normal:
The surface normal at the contact point.

**Used for** classifying or orienting a response to the contact.
fields.rid:
The physics server RID of the object found by the query.

**Used for** addressing the collider in a later physics server operation.
fields.collider_id:
The instance ID of the Godot object found by the query.

**Used for** looking up the Godot object associated with the result by instance ID.
fields.shape:
The index of the matching shape on the collider.

**Used for** selecting which of the collider's shapes the query found.
fields.linear_velocity:
The collider's linear velocity at the contact point.

**Used for** accounting for movement of the collider at the contact.

PhysicsServer2DExtensionMotionResult.description:
The displacement and collision information returned by a 2D body motion test.

**Used for** applying the travel from a 2D motion test and deciding how to respond to a collision.

fields.travel:
The displacement completed by the body during the motion test.

**Used for** applying the part of the requested displacement completed by the motion test.
fields.remainder:
The portion of the requested displacement left after the test.

**Used for** deciding how much of the requested displacement is left for another movement step.
fields.collision_depth:
The penetration depth reported by the motion test.

**Used for** reporting the amount of penetration along with the result of the motion test.
fields.collision_safe_fraction:
The fraction of the requested motion that can be completed without a collision.

**Used for** choosing a fraction of the requested movement that remains clear.
fields.collision_unsafe_fraction:
The fraction of the requested motion at which the test detects a collision.

**Used for** locating the colliding side of the safe-to-unsafe movement interval.
fields.collision_point:
The reported collision point in world coordinates.

**Used for** locating the reported contact after the movement test.
fields.collision_normal:
The collider's surface normal at the collision point.

**Used for** classifying a hit or choosing a slide direction.
fields.collider_velocity:
The collider's velocity at the collision point.

**Used for** accounting for the collider's movement at the contact.
fields.collision_local_shape:
The index of the shape on the moving body that collided.

**Used for** finding the moving body's shape that made contact.
fields.collider_id:
The instance ID of the Godot object found by the query.

**Used for** looking up the hit Godot object by instance ID.
fields.collider:
The physics server RID of the collider.

**Used for** addressing the hit collider in the physics server.
fields.collider_shape:
The index of the matching shape on the collider.

**Used for** selecting the shape on the collider that caused the hit.

PhysicsServer3DExtensionMotionCollision.description:
One collision reported by a 3D body motion test.

**Used for** examining one contact from a 3D motion test with multiple reported collisions.

fields.position:
The reported collision point in world coordinates.

**Used for** locating the contact to report it or apply a response there.
fields.normal:
The collider's surface normal at the collision point.

**Used for** classifying the contact as a floor, wall, or ceiling relative to an up direction.
fields.collider_velocity:
The collider's linear velocity reported at the collision.

**Used for** accounting for movement of the collider at the contact.
fields.collider_angular_velocity:
The collider's angular velocity reported at the collision.

**Used for** accounting for rotation of the collider when processing the contact.
fields.depth:
The penetration depth reported for this collision.

**Used for** comparing the penetration reported for this contact with other contacts.
fields.local_shape:
The index of the shape on the moving body that collided.

**Used for** finding the shape on the moving body that made contact.
fields.collider_id:
The instance ID of the Godot object found by the query.

**Used for** looking up the hit Godot object by instance ID.
fields.collider:
The physics server RID of the collider.

**Used for** addressing the hit collider in the physics server.
fields.collider_shape:
The index of the matching shape on the collider.

**Used for** selecting the shape on the collider that caused the hit.

PhysicsServer3DExtensionMotionResult.description:
The displacement and list of collisions returned by a 3D body motion test.

**Used for** applying tested 3D travel and processing the contacts from that movement.

fields.travel:
The displacement completed by the body during the motion test.

**Used for** applying the part of the requested displacement completed by the motion test.
fields.remainder:
The portion of the requested displacement left after the test.

**Used for** deciding how much of the requested displacement is left for another movement step.
fields.collision_depth:
The penetration depth reported by the motion test.

**Used for** reporting the amount of penetration along with the result of the motion test.
fields.collision_safe_fraction:
The fraction of the requested motion that can be completed without a collision.

**Used for** choosing a fraction of the requested movement that remains clear.
fields.collision_unsafe_fraction:
The fraction of the requested motion at which the test detects a collision.

**Used for** locating the colliding side of the safe-to-unsafe movement interval.
fields.collisions:
Storage for up to 32 motion contacts. Entries starting at the collision count are outside the result.

**Used for** reading the reported contact records up to the collision count.
fields.collision_count:
The number of entries in the collisions array written by the test.

**Used for** iterating only the entries written by the motion test.

ScriptLanguageExtensionProfilingInfo.description:
A script function's profiling record supplied by a script language extension.

**Used for** returning one function's timing and call count to the script profiler.

fields.signature:
The signature identifying the profiled function.

**Used for** grouping timing records by the profiled function.
fields.call_count:
The number of calls recorded for the function.

**Used for** calculating the average execution time per call.
fields.total_time:
The accumulated time attributed to this function, including its callees.

**Used for** finding functions whose complete call trees account for the most execution time.
fields.self_time:
The accumulated time spent in this function's own execution.

**Used for** finding functions whose own execution accounts for the most time.
